title: Set up an out-of-office reply
symptom: User wants an automatic out-of-office reply
user_description: I'm on leave from tomorrow for two weeks. How do I make Outlook tell people I'm away?

options.text: Set a rule to forward all her mail to a colleague without telling them
options.why: Sends private mail to someone without consent and is a privacy problem. It is not the same as an out-of-office reply.

options.text: Add 'I'm on leave' to her email signature
options.why: People would only see it after she replies, so it does not answer anyone who emails while she is away.

options.text: Show her how to turn on Automatic Replies, set the start and end dates, and write separate messages for people inside and outside the company
options.why: Automatic Replies answer people for her on set dates. Separate messages let you give colleagues more detail than outsiders.

options.text: Tell her to reply manually every day from home
options.why: Defeats the purpose of being on leave and is unreliable.

hints: Which feature in Outlook replies for you automatically?
Why might you write different messages for colleagues and outsiders?
How do you make it stop by itself?
real_world_tip: Tell her to include who to contact for urgent matters. It saves a lot of follow-up emails.
